title: Operations on constructible functions and generalized valuations
summary: Alesker's theory of generalized valuations unifies smooth measures and constructible functions on real analytic manifolds, extending classical operations on functions and measures. Alesker showed that these operations agree with the sheaf-theoretic ones on constructible functions under restrictive assumptions, leaving key aspects conjectural. In this article, we close this gap by proving that the two approaches indeed coincide on constructible functions under mild transversality assumptions.
